fields.name: name
fields.description: The descriptive label for this tag.

fields.name: parentId
fields.description: Reference to the parent tag in the hierarchy; empty marks a root.

fields.name: docId
fields.description: The open record's id, stashed at SHOW_TAG_STRIP so commits know which row to update.

fields.name: docTagIds
fields.description: The open record's current tag ids, stashed at SHOW_TAG_STRIP for membership tests.

fields.name: pendingTagName
fields.description: The tag name typed or clicked on add, held across the resolve fetch.

fields.name: pendingNames
fields.description: The chip names remaining after a remove, held across the resolve fetch.

events.name: TAGS_CHANGED
events.description: The record's tag set changed (chip added or removed); the host routes this into its persistor's update so the write and the refetch stay the organism's.
events.synonyms: tags updated, tag set changed, retagged

events.name: ADD_TAG
events.description: A tag name was typed into the strip or an existing tag's suggestion chip was clicked.

events.name: REMOVE_TAG
events.description: A chip's remove affordance was clicked; value carries the names that remain.

events.name: TagStripOptions
events.description: The shared tag store loaded for the display pass.

events.name: TagStripAddOptions
events.description: The shared tag store loaded to resolve a typed name on add.

events.name: TagStripRemoveOptions
events.description: The shared tag store loaded to resolve the remaining names on remove.

events.name: TagStripTagCreated
events.description: A typed name had no existing tag; a fresh row was created in the shared taxonomy.

events.name: TagStripLoadFailed
events.description: The tag store fetch or create failed.

events.name: SHOW_TAG_STRIP
events.description: Scope the strip to the open record — routed from the document's load events; carries the record's id and current tag ids (hydrated tag rows are normalized to their ids at stash time, so include-hydrated fetches route straight through).
events.synonyms: load tags, scope tag strip, show tags

overridableConfigKeys.label: Helper text
overridableConfigKeys.description: Optional helper line under the input

overridableConfigKeys.label: Read-only?
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true the strip renders nothing — no add input, no remove, no suggestion chips. Hosts pass a role condition here so read-only viewers rely on the record's read-only rails (which keep showing the tags) instead of an editing surface.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: read only tags, viewer mode, no tag editing, hide tag input

overridableConfigKeys.label: Strip caption
overridableConfigKeys.description: Small caption above the chips; empty hides it

capabilities: inline tags, tag chips on a document, add tag from taxonomy, create tag by typing, remove tag chip, tag editing in place
